name: dot field condenses then a big stat counter lands
looks: A scattered field of blue dots over a dark starfield condenses into a dense halftone circle. It cross-fades into a huge number counting up against the same starfield, with a small caption beneath naming what it counts, and a thin progress bar with two mono labels ("verified" / "calculated") ticking at the bottom edge.
build: noise-dissolve-logomark for the dot condense: seeded points ease from scattered starting positions to a circular target grid on power3.out. Cross-fade into a data-infographic-style digit roll-up (vertical blur during the count) for the big number, with a live-readout-hud strip (two mono values, no easing) pinned to the bottom.
sound: A soft shimmer as the dots gather, a rising tone under the count, a tick on each readout update.
prompt: Over a starfield, let a loose field of dots condense into a dense circular cluster, then collapse into a single large number counting up with a short caption beneath it naming what the number represents. Run a thin live readout strip along the bottom edge with two small changing values, to make the count feel measured rather than decorative.
